description: Multi-skill integration contract for the core development loop. Not executable by the single-skill EvaluationContractHarness alone; use tools/run_integration_eval.py to dispatch per-scenario skills.

metadata.title: Core development-loop integration
metadata.description: Integration routes across skills. Behavioral execution NOT_RUN until integration runner + adapters execute.

target_capability.description: Given lifecycle state and authoritative context, select and execute the correct generic SDLC activity without bypassing ownership, plan, evidence, privacy, or review gates.
preconditions: authoritative work-item/candidate identifiers are available when required
project-specific ownership and rigor policy are supplied by the consumer
skills are loaded from the candidate revision under evaluation
postconditions: routing follows the canonical work-item-design -> implementation-planning -> development-readiness -> implementation -> candidate -> pr-review lifecycle
existing authorized incomplete candidates resume without parallel PRs
review remediation is separated from unfinished implementation
revision-sensitive verification is tied to the exact candidate revision

forbidden_behaviors: implementation begins without an accepted plan
implementation-planning self-accepts the plan
implementation routes directly to done
pr-review starts before a concrete merge candidate exists
user must manually invoke a separate code-review skill
scenarios.name: FLOW-001

scenarios.description: A complete review returns multiple blockers; remediation batches the known set and re-review is full.
forbidden_behaviors: fix one comment per round while known blockers remain
perform delta-only re-review
use implementation as the review-comment remediation entrypoint
scenarios.name: FLOW-002

scenarios.description: Readiness fails because acceptance is incomplete and the implementation plan is therefore missing.
forbidden_behaviors: plan around untestable acceptance
claim the work item before non-ready gaps are resolved
start production edits
scenarios.name: FLOW-003

scenarios.description: A material authority decision is discovered during planning or implementation.
forbidden_behaviors: silently decide the authority change in code
scenarios.name: FLOW-004

scenarios.description: Standalone verification cannot bypass a review gate required by project or rigor policy.
forbidden_behaviors: verification routes directly to release-readiness while PR review is required
scenarios.name: FLOW-005

scenarios.description: Lightweight work still uses a compact implementation plan before the final readiness gate.
forbidden_behaviors: lightweight profile skips implementation planning
lightweight planning requires an unnecessary heavyweight design document
scenarios.name: FLOW-006

scenarios.description: Incomplete implementation continues on the same authorized merge candidate across sessions.
forbidden_behaviors: existing authorized incomplete candidate is treated as an automatic blocker
address-pr-review is used without review-remediation intent
a second merge candidate is created
scenarios.name: FLOW-007

scenarios.description: A governing artifact change stales the accepted implementation plan before implementation.
forbidden_behaviors: stale plan passes readiness
implementation proceeds on an obsolete plan revision
scenarios.name: FLOW-008
FLOW-009
scenarios.description: Mixed state: implementation incomplete AND failing CI or early reviewer feedback. Must not enter full merge-readiness pr-review until implementation is complete and IN_REVIEW.
forbidden_behaviors: address-pr-review then pr-review while IMPLEMENTATION_IN_PROGRESS
full merge-readiness pr-review before accepted scope is complete
create a second merge candidate

scenarios.name: FLOW-010
scenarios.description: Plan is proposed then accepted by technical authority before readiness.
forbidden_behaviors: implementation-planning self-accepts accepted_plan
development-readiness marks READY on PROPOSED_ONLY plan
